pred_texts: Instruct: Get half cup of flour and pour it into a mixing bowl.
Instruct: Get half cup of sugar and add it to the mixing bowl with the flour.
Instruct: Now add one teaspoon of baking powder to the contents of the mixing bowl.
Instruct: Now use a fork to mix the dry ingredients in the mixing bowl together.
Instruct: Now take three tablespoons of butter and put it in a microwave safe bowl.
Instruct: Now microwave the butter in the bowl for about 30 seconds.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now add the melted butter to the dry ingredients in the mixing bowl.
Instruct: Now let's add a half cup of milk to the cake mixture in the mixing bowl.
Instruct: Now use a hand mixer to mix the ingredients in the mixing bowl for about 1 minute.
Instruct: Now add two eggs to the cake mixture.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now mix the eggs until the cake mixture is smooth and well blended, for about 1 minute.
Instruct: Now add about half cup of chocolate chips to the cake mixture.
Instruct: Now you can use the hand mixture to blend the cake mixture again for around 15 to 30 seconds, until the chocolate chips are well incorporated.
Instruct: Now get a small baking loaf tray and then coat it with oil or butter, whatever you prefer.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now add the cake mixture to the baking tray. You can use a spoon or a fork to make it easier.
Instruct: Now turn on the oven and set the temperature to 360 degrees Fahrenheit.
Instruct: Now put the baking tray in the oven.
Success: Step complete.
